clue.text: Consider a set of books used by professional adviser

parts.note: to consult is to consider or take into account
NT, the New Testament, is a set of books of the Bible

explanation.surface: Someone weighs up a set of books recommended by a professional adviser.
explanation.definitionFit: A consultant is an expert whom clients pay for advice.

clue.text: Patient example

explanation.surface: A sick person serves as an illustration.
explanation.definitionFit: A doctor speaks of a patient as a case, and a case is also an instance or example of something.

clue.text: The importance of money perhaps

explanation.surface: Wealth is what really matters.
explanation.definitionFit: Something of note has importance, and a banknote is paper money.

clue.text: Wicked one abroad removing centre of an evergreen tree

parts.note: UN is French for one, a foreign word for one

indicators.note: the central letter of the tree's name is taken out of the word

parts.note: the holly is an evergreen tree

explanation.surface: A villain overseas strips the heart from a Christmas tree.
explanation.walkthrough: HOLLY has five letters, so its centre is the middle L; removing it leaves HOLY after UN.
explanation.definitionFit: Unholy describes something sinful or evil, the opposite of sacred.

clue.text: An encounter at the summit?

parts.note: a meeting on a mountain top, or a summit meeting between the most senior leaders

explanation.definitionFit: A summit is a conference of heads of state, a meeting at the highest level.

clue.text: Hard to please with nearly new creed

parts.note: nice in its older sense means fastidious or fussy

indicators.note: nearly says the word loses its final letter

parts.note: the word new taken as written before trimming

explanation.surface: A fussy person adopts a nearly new set of beliefs.
explanation.definitionFit: The Nicene Creed is the statement of Christian faith agreed at the Council of Nicaea.

clue.text: Smart unknowledgeable bird?

indicators.note: read as un-K-nowledgeable: without the K that starts knowledge

parts.note: a chick is a young bird

explanation.surface: A stylish young woman who is not very bright.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Unknowledgeable' is split: knowledge begins with K, so being without knowledge drops the K from CHICK.
explanation.definitionFit: Chic means fashionable and elegant, as smart clothes are.

clue.text: Lusty animal reportedly found roaming in Africa

definitions.note: the definition is a description, standing for the creature that roams Africa

indicators.note: reportedly says the words are heard spoken rather than read

parts.note: a hearty beast: lusty means hearty, an animal is a beast

explanation.surface: A vigorous creature is said to wander the African plains.
explanation.definitionFit: The hartebeest is a large antelope of the African savanna.

clue.text: Make notes in a tent whilst soliciting votes

parts.note: canvas stands for a tent, as in camping under canvas
to sing is to make musical notes

explanation.surface: A campaigner jots notes in a tent while out chasing votes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Make notes' suggests writing, but here it means producing musical notes.
explanation.definitionFit: Canvassing is going round asking people for their support at an election.

clue.text: What the leader will do will determine the going rate for others

definitions.text: will determine the going rate for others

explanation.surface: A front-runner decides how fast everyone else must go.
explanation.definitionFit: Whoever leads a race fixes its speed, and in business a leader fixes the standard others follow.

clue.text: Naval female architect

explanation.surface: A woman in the navy designs buildings.
explanation.walkthrough: A Wren was a member of the Women's Royal Naval Service; Sir Christopher Wren designed St Paul's Cathedral in London.
explanation.definitionFit: The WRNS were nicknamed after its initials, and the famous English architect bore the surname.

clue.text: Depending on part of the military force

explanation.surface: Something hinges on a section of the army.
explanation.definitionFit: Contingent on means conditional upon, and a contingent is a detachment of troops.

clue.text: Engineers answer with determination

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British Army corps
a solution is an answer to a problem

explanation.surface: Army engineers solve a problem through sheer persistence.
explanation.definitionFit: Resolution is firmness of purpose, being resolute.

clue.text: Running away feeling ill

indicators.note: ill means badly formed here, so the word's letters are put into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone flees because they are unwell.
explanation.definitionFit: Fleeing is escaping from danger, taking flight.

clue.text: One upholding the standard

parts.note: read as someone keeping up a level of quality, but it is a person holding a flag aloft

explanation.definitionFit: A standard is a banner, and the person who carries or waves the banner holds it up.

clue.text: Variety of noughts coming from a rifle perhaps

definitions.note: a description standing for what a rifle discharges

indicators.note: a variety of the word means its letters arranged differently

explanation.surface: Many zeroes are produced by a marksman's weapon.
explanation.definitionFit: A gunshot is the firing of a gun, a rifle being one example.

clue.text: Knitted one ply straight from the shoulder

indicators.note: knitted means worked together into a new pattern, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Single-ply wool knitted to hang straight from the shoulder of a garment.
explanation.definitionFit: Speaking straight from the shoulder means speaking frankly, without concealment.

clue.text: I have discovered a Greek expression

explanation.surface: Someone announces a find in ancient Greek.
explanation.walkthrough: Archimedes is said to have shouted this Greek word, meaning 'I have found it', on discovering displacement in his bath.
explanation.definitionFit: The Greek exclamation translates as 'I have found it' and is used as a cry of triumph.

clue.text: Characteristic of those who are unmindful of others

definitions.text: Characteristic of those who are unmindful of others

parts.words: Characteristic of those who are unmindful of others
parts.note: names the trait shown by selfish people who never consider anyone else

explanation.definitionFit: Inconsiderate people show a lack of care or regard, the quality of not thinking of others.

clue.text: Needed a gun to remove the sticky sweet

indicators.note: read as re-move: the letters are moved round again into a new order

explanation.surface: A gun was required to dislodge some stubborn toffee.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Needed' is a link; the fodder is A GUN TO, and 'remove' is read as move again.
explanation.definitionFit: Nougat is a chewy confection of sugar or honey, nuts and egg white.

clue.text: To play very quietly using the continental pitch

parts.note: pp, pianissimo, is the musical direction to play very quietly
le is French for the, the continental form

explanation.surface: A pianist plays softly using the European concert pitch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pitch' looks musical, but it means fall or tumble.
explanation.definitionFit: To pitch forward is to fall headlong, as something toppling over does.

clue.text: Poison, sound the alarm

indicators.note: sound tells the solver to listen to how the word is said

parts.note: a toxin is a poison

explanation.surface: A warning cry that someone has been poisoned.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sound the alarm' reads as one instruction, but 'sound' is the homophone signal between the poison and the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A tocsin is an alarm bell or warning signal.

clue.text: Four o'clock service

parts.note: looks like a church service in the afternoon, but means the crockery brought out for an afternoon cup

explanation.definitionFit: Afternoon tea is traditionally taken around four, and a service is a set of matching china.

clue.text: Letter about school restriction

indicators.note: about says the school's name is turned round

parts.note: Eton is the famous English public school
a let is a hindrance or obstruction, as in 'without let or hindrance'

explanation.surface: A head writes about curbs on pupils.
explanation.definitionFit: A notelet is a small folded card used for writing a short letter.

clue.text: Not the right time to give out

indicators.note: not the right way round means the word is read backwards

explanation.surface: It is the wrong moment to hand things out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not the right time' seems to mean a bad moment, but 'not the right' way round turns TIME back to front.
explanation.definitionFit: To emit is to send forth or discharge, such as light or a sound.

clue.text: Low point for satellite

parts.note: to low is to moo, as cattle do
N, north, is a point of the compass

explanation.surface: A bad moment for a spacecraft.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Low point' reads as a nadir; 'low' is the cow's call.
explanation.definitionFit: The Moon is the Earth's natural satellite.

clue.text: Number of horses bolt

explanation.surface: A group of horses runs away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bolt' suggests a horse running off, but here it is a metal fastener.
explanation.definitionFit: A stud is a breeding establishment's herd of horses, and also a stud bolt or fastening.

clue.text: In meddling he ruins the drink

definitions.note: the definition describes a person, the one who meddles

parts.note: to spoil something is to ruin it
port is a fortified wine

explanation.surface: An interfering man ruins the wine.
explanation.definitionFit: A killjoy who interferes stops others enjoying themselves.

clue.text: Hazel comes back with a fish

indicators.note: comes back means the word is read in reverse

parts.note: a hazel is a nut tree, so hazel gives a nut

explanation.surface: Hazel returns from the shop with a fish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hazel' looks like a woman's name, but it is the hazelnut.
explanation.definitionFit: The tuna is a large ocean fish of the mackerel family.

clue.text: Encouraging cry of Edmund accepting number that had become more intense

indicators.note: accepting means taking the number inside the other letters

parts.note: heigh is an old shout of encouragement
Ed is short for Edmund
ten is a number

explanation.surface: Cheers for Edmund grew louder once the crowd swelled.
explanation.definitionFit: To heighten is to intensify, so heightened means made stronger or raised in degree.
